timing_note: Local wall times under concurrent development, not a controlled performance benchmark. Python startup excluded; method imports included.

method_notes.respyre_of: Exact upstream OF waveform function, common harness detrend+bandpass+FFT readout, selected ROI resized160x120. Not full resPyre evaluator.
method_notes.respyre_dof: Exact upstream DoF function on uint8 ROI frames, same harness readout. Not our signed PIC method.
method_notes.lightweight: Unmodified ImproveOpticalFlow defaults FSS/CGOF/filter/Normalization enabled, original native FFT reported; full frame input. Additional native rate estimators retained.
method_notes.ours: Signed PIC/PCA, operator ROI for synthetic and reference, center ROI for MPSC, optional YOLO off; all quality gates enabled. No fitting on VRWi.

limitations: Four reference windows from one subject; no generalization claim.
Reference rates derived from independent belts, not clinical labels.
Video zero alignment to first belt timestamp follows author preprocessing and was not independently verified.
Methods use different preprocessing and native output policies; these numbers describe specific runnable configurations, not a controlled ranking of all papers.
MPSC-RR has no released reference rates; never included in MAE.

reasons: no signs of life detected, low confidence
